name: zeffect_animate_camera_params_over_time
description: zEffect::AnimateCameraParamsOverTime initializes, interpolates, and completes flagged animated camera parameters for a target node reference.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this event handler; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect event-handler/source-cluster pass.
